title: Moby Dick: launch questions
lede: Veronica answered the first ten Moby Dick questions on September 9. Thank you. Two things are left. Each part sends itself to Nicholas a few seconds after you stop typing and keeps a copy on your phone.

qs.t: Who is approved to buy from Moby Dick? Where is that list?
qs.w: On the new Moby Dick website every old account came over as approved, because the file we had for Moby Dick did not say who was approved and who had only registered. Upper Deck's file did. To fix Moby Dick we need the real list.
opts: The office system (Acctivate) has it: Nicholas or the tech guy pulls the active Moby Dick customers
The old Moby Dick website's user list (Nicholas logs into its admin)
